title: Unknown coupon code crashes checkout with a NullPointerException
body:
`Service.checkout` should leave the amount alone when the coupon code is
not in the map. Instead the whole checkout blows up.

```bash
javac -d out $(find src/main -name '*.java')
java -cp out com.example.shop.Service
```

```
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.IllegalStateException: checkout failed
	at com.example.shop.Service.checkout(Service.java:11)
	at com.example.shop.Service.main(Service.java:16)
Caused by: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "java.lang.Integer.intValue()" because the return value of "java.util.Map.get(Object)" is null
	at com.example.shop.Pricing.applyCoupon(Pricing.java:13)
	at com.example.shop.Service.checkout(Service.java:9)
	... 1 more
```

`PricingTest.unknownCouponIsIgnored` covers the same path.
